result.summary: Found 1 major visual defect: overlapping, unreadable text in the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card metadata. Other partially visible items are intentional horizontal scrolling and bottom-of-viewport cutoff.

issues.description: The metadata line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' in the 'Popular right now' section is garbled with overlapping text — characters from two strings (e.g. '25-30 min' and 'delivery / Order') are rendered on top of each other, making the delivery time and details unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout constraints / text rendering for that card's subtitle so only one metadata string is displayed on a single line, e.g. '25-30 min delivery • Ramen', with no overlapping elements.
